chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Sa'id ibn Ghazwan, from Abi Basir, from Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
There will be nine Imams after al-Hussein ibn Ali, the ninth of whom is their Riser (peace be upon them).
ai.seo_question: How many Imams are there after Imam Husayn according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* explicitly confirms the count of nine Imams descending from Imam al-Husayn, thereby completing the total of twelve when including Imam Ali al-Hadi. It highlights the eschatological role of the ninth Imam as 'Al-Qa'im', anchoring the doctrine of Imamah in the progeny of Husayn and reinforcing the continuity of divine leadership through the Ahl al-Bayt.
